review_description: Original quote started at 23k. After realising how inflated the quote was, I got them down to 15k. The only reason I went ahead was because I was told it would cost 3k to break contract.Installation went ok, installer did break my roof mounted antenna however I wasn’t too worried as we don’t watch free to air tv anywayFast forward to December 2023 and one of my inverters stopped working, I didn’t realise until getting a large power bill in March 2024 (disappointing because I was told they monitored systems and would know of any failures). Initial customer service was very good, we went through troubleshooting only to determine an electrician would be required. I was told to organise an electrician at my cost and have a report written up for them, which I did. An independent electrician told me I was lucky I hadn’t had a fire as the feed in cable to the inverter was installed too tightly (cable stretched) causing a poor connection resulting in ongoing ‘arcing out’ at the connection point. This caused the fitting and end of cable to melt over time before inverter eventually stopped working. Over the last few months I have sent numerous emails and called numerous times to no avail. All I have been told is their head electrician is reviewing the report and photos from my independent electrician. This shouldn’t take months, I feel like they’re just waiting it out for me to just sort myself

-the sales/quoting was a bit on the expensive side, but the deal they made was for all hooked up to regulations, working, no hidden costs. I have an old house, so I didn't a price blow out if they had problems.-the installation went well, very polite, very tidy, however took a bit longer to complete as they were overextended with work and had to source special parts to complete the job. On the other hand, very professional job done.-didn't have to lift a finger everything was sorted by them.did not do all the ratings above, the jury is still out whether it is value for money or a quality system as it has to pass the test of time yet, so far so good
